title: Critique: which experiences are possible is settled in the visual system

statements.text: Whether an experience of red with no specific shade, or of red and green all over, is possible is a question for the visual system, for example its opponent processes. The higher-order theory, having dropped first-order states from experience, would have to settle it by examining thoughts.

sources.quote: The less obvious problem is that the HOT theory makes the wrong prediction for how to answer the question.
it is obvious that the real scientific issue is to be resolved via examining the visual system itself
